risk_note: B1-22ze (union, RV2; BR-ID-24; takes over B1-22zd, D10-3121 / D10-3123). Hour alert nodes union.auth_alert_hours with the skip rule (lead time >= total authorization length), hour jobs scheduled on reauthorization / manual credentials / refresh and backfilled daily, the five Taobao durations recorded on union_credentials (migration 0156), auth_refreshable on the admin account rows (CT-24ha). Backend alerts become a persistent record: union_auth_alerts (migration 0156, unique (app_id, union_account_id, stage, alert_key), append-only trigger, app role INSERT / SELECT) written in the same transaction as hour_alert_key / alert_stage / notify_logs; the original log line is printed by an alert_log job (queue union-auth, payload ids only) enqueued in that transaction only when the insert returns a row — log at least once, record exactly once. Expired SMS dedupe key takes the same entered-at instant as the record (notification/site-auth-alert, ledger patch 2, D10-3164). tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts expected funds set gains union_auth_alerts (ledger patch 1, D10-3125, precedent #2932). Migration renumbered 0155 -> 0156 after main took 0155 (B1-04zzzzp), SQL unchanged, snapshot regenerated (main copy byte-identical).

reviews.note: Codex money review via tools/agent/codex-run.sh (implementation by Opus, approvals 27). Under B1-22ze: r1 (full) fail 4 S1 (entered-at instant read twice; hour job delay from the transaction start; time read before the row lock; a config read failure blocked reauthorization) -> implementation r2; r2 fail 2 S1 (the notification planner still read its own clock for the expired dedupe key; the first schedule skipped an hour node already due at commit) -> ledger patch 2 (D10-3164) and implementation r3; r3 pass, no findings. No finding was moved to out_of_scope in any round (D10-2954). Before the takeover, B1-22zd had money r1-r4 by Codex, all fail; the two S1 of r3 / r4 (backend alert log written outside the transaction) are what the persistent record fixes (couli-runs/B1-22zd/review-money-r{1..4}.json). After r3 passed, the only changes are rule tests and data: write-test 3 (kit.ts back to main byte for byte; the four monitor.int.test.ts blocks each gain the step that runs this round's alert_log jobs, D10-3197 / D10-3238), the migration renumbered 0155 -> 0156 and the snapshot regenerated on the rebased main; the implementation source is unchanged since r3.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by Codex. Under B1-22ze: r1 (full) fail 2 S1 + 1 S2 -> write-test 2; r2 (incremental) pass; write-test 3 (kit.ts back to main: the harness wrapper of D10-3074 cannot pass the support-file pure-insertion rule; the same owner-approved step, D10-3129 (3), moved into the four monitor.int.test.ts blocks, D10-3197; approvals 216) -> r3 (incremental) pass, no findings. Validator moved 0 in every round (one reviewer-listed out_of_scope S2 on notification quiet hours). Under B1-22zd before the takeover: r1 fail 3 S1, r2 pass, r3 pass.
